rounds: Voting should be compulsory, as it is in Australia.
Sixteen-year-olds should be able to vote in every election.
Politicians should be paid more, so that better people go into politics.
Famous people with no political experience can make good politicians.
Voting on your phone should replace polling stations.
Political adverts should be banned on social media.
Cities should have more say than national governments over housing and transport.
Most people vote for a party’s leader, not its policies.
